svg.title: ICMPv6 Neighbor Solicitation
svg.desc: The ICMPv6 Neighbor Solicitation of frame 1 of icmpv6_neighbor_solicitation.pcapng, 32 bits per row: type 135, code 0, checksum 0x44b7, a reserved word, the target address 2001:db8:1:2::1000 and one option, Source Link-Layer Address (type 1, length 1) carrying 00:0c:29:2f:80:31; Icmpv6Packet keeps the common header as fields and the body as Icmpv6Body::NeighborSolicitation.

text.font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
